summary.zh: 以AI分析醫學影像，協助偵測心肺、腦部疾病風險。
summary.en: AI medical-imaging startup detecting cardiopulmonary and brain disease risks.

overview.zh: 神瑞人工智慧由臺北醫學大學影像醫學與AI團隊於2023年共同創立，運用AI分析醫療影像。核心產品DeepLung-CAC可從一張低劑量CT同時偵測肺結節、冠狀動脈鈣化與骨質疏鬆，DeepBrain-Cognito則以MRI分析腦齡並預測失智風險。全台已有超過29家醫院採用，並於日、美、泰展開取證。
overview.en: Founded in 2023 by a Taipei Medical University imaging-AI team, DeepRad.AI applies AI to medical imaging. Its DeepLung-CAC detects lung nodules, coronary artery calcification and osteoporosis from a single low-dose CT, while DeepBrain-Cognito uses MRI to assess brain age and predict dementia risk. Over 29 hospitals in Taiwan use its software, with validation underway in Japan, the US and Thailand.

summary.zh: 提供雲地互聯的邊緣協作軟體，整合IT與OT助企業數位轉型。
summary.en: Edge orchestration software bridging IT and OT for cloud-to-edge digital transformation.

overview.zh: 雲界數位創新成立於2025年，為台灣雲端服務品牌eCloudvalley策略投資的新創團隊，成員來自工業自動化與IT領域。旗艦產品NeoEdge為邊緣協作軟體，打破IT與OT藩籬，支援快速資料整合、設備管理、應用部署與具資安的AIoT解決方案。
overview.en: Established in 2025 as a strategic-investment startup backed by Taiwan's leading cloud brand eCloudvalley, eCloudEdge brings together industrial-automation and IT experts. Its flagship NeoEdge edge-orchestration platform breaks down IT/OT barriers, enabling rapid data integration, device management, application deployment and secure AIoT solutions.

summary.zh: （依名稱與參賽組別推估）從事醫藥保健產品的研發與國際銷售。
summary.en: (inferred from name and track) Develops and internationally markets pharmaceutical and health products.

overview.zh: （依名稱與參賽組別推估）惠生醫藥國際應為一家專注於醫藥、保健或健康產品的企業，名稱中的「國際」可能指涉跨境銷售或進出口業務。歸屬消費生活組，研判其產品面向健康消費市場。本資料未能查得該公司確切的公開來源，僅依公司名稱與參賽組別推估。
overview.en: (inferred from name and track) Hui Sheng Pharma International appears to focus on pharmaceutical, health or wellness products, with 'International' suggesting cross-border sales or import/export. Placed in the consumer/lifestyle track, it likely targets the health-consumer market. No confirmed public source was found; this entry is inferred from the company name and competition track.

summary.zh: 整合治療師等專業，提供企業職場健康促進與賦能服務。
summary.en: Workplace health-promotion services delivered by an interdisciplinary team of health professionals.

overview.zh: 米蔚健康顧問定位為『醫療專業』與『健康生活』的中繼站(Midway)，集結治療師、心理師、營養師、運動教練等約91位健康專業人員，以職場健康促進與健康產業賦能兩種形式為企業服務。已累積約500間企業客戶，舉辦超過1,000場次職場健康活動。
overview.en: Midway positions itself as the bridge between medical expertise and healthy living, assembling roughly 91 professionals including therapists, psychologists, dietitians and fitness coaches. It serves enterprises through workplace health-promotion and health-industry enablement programs, having accumulated around 500 corporate clients and delivered over 1,000 workplace health sessions.

summary.zh: 研發高效能動物疫苗與疾病檢測技術的生技新創。
summary.en: Biotech startup developing high-efficiency animal vaccines and disease detection.

overview.zh: 展興生物科技於2022年由中興大學趙裕展教授團隊在國科會科研創業計畫支持下成立，聚焦疫苗開發與疾病檢測。趙教授曾任中研院研究員、深耕病毒致病機轉與疫苗藥物研發逾30年。公司已成功開發較傳統疫苗更具效力的新型豬流行性下痢疫苗。
overview.en: Founded in 2022 by Professor Chao Yu-chan's team at National Chung Hsing University under the NSTC science-entrepreneurship program, BacuNova focuses on vaccine development and disease detection. Prof. Chao, a former Academia Sinica researcher with over 30 years in viral pathogenesis and vaccine R&D, has led the development of a porcine epidemic diarrhea vaccine more effective than conventional ones.

summary.zh: 車載軟體系統整合商，提供符合AUTOSAR的電動車ECU解決方案。
summary.en: Automotive software integrator delivering AUTOSAR-compliant ECU solutions for EVs.

overview.zh: 科飛數位為工研院spin-off新創，定位車載軟體開發系統整合商，提供符合國際AUTOSAR標準的整合解決方案，包含AUTOSAR ECU、開放控制器與車載韌體。公司為汽車與Tier1供應商提供完整ECU方案，已取得台灣多數電動巴士訂單，為台灣唯一國產符合AUTOSAR架構的車載軟韌體開發公司。
overview.en: Spun off from ITRI, Kopherbit is an automotive-software system integrator providing AUTOSAR-compliant solutions including AUTOSAR ECUs, open controllers and in-vehicle firmware. Serving automakers and Tier-1 suppliers with complete ECU solutions, it has won orders for most of Taiwan's electric buses and is Taiwan's only domestic AUTOSAR-architecture in-vehicle software/firmware developer.

summary.zh: 以米麥取代鮮奶油，製作無人工添加的天然小批次冰淇淋。
summary.en: Maker of small-batch natural ice cream using rice and barley instead of heavy cream.

overview.zh: 好時食食品成立於2022年，登記於台南／屏東，品牌為Bebopice。公司以天然食材製作小批次冰淇淋，採用米與大麥取代鮮奶油，標榜不添加人工添加物，主打健康與在地原料的點心市場。
overview.en: Founded in 2022 and registered in Tainan/Pingtung, Bebopice makes small-batch ice cream from natural ingredients, replacing heavy cream with rice and barley and using no artificial additives, targeting the healthy, locally-sourced dessert market.

summary.zh: （依名稱與參賽組別推估）從事農作物友善耕作與在地農產生產。
summary.en: (inferred from name and track) A farm engaged in crop cultivation and local agricultural production.

overview.zh: （依名稱與參賽組別推估）順月農園應為一處農園，從事農作物栽培與農產品生產，可能採友善或永續耕作方式。歸屬綠色永續組，研判其經營方向著重永續農業與在地農產。本資料未能查得該農園確切的公開來源，僅依名稱與參賽組別推估。
overview.en: (inferred from name and track) Shun Yue Farm appears to be a farm engaged in crop cultivation and agricultural production, possibly using friendly or sustainable practices. Placed in the green/sustainability track, its focus likely centers on sustainable agriculture and local produce. No confirmed public source was found; this entry is inferred from the name and competition track.

summary.zh: 以永續養殖黑蜆製作即食水產品，品牌「壹顆蜆」。
summary.en: Sustainably-farmed black-clam ready-to-eat products under the brand 1Koshijimi.

overview.zh: 海寶珍品工作坊位於彰化縣芳苑鄉，由漁二代楊雅閔經營，品牌「壹顆蜆」主打黑蜆相關產品，如沖熱水即食的黑蜆炊粉與滷蜆冷凍包。標榜永續養殖、取得ASC國際永續水產認證與有機水產認證，並以蜆殼再製環保包裝，重視在地與社區連結。
overview.en: Based in Fangyuan Township, Changhua, Haibao Treasure Workshop is run by second-generation fisher Yang Ya-min under the brand 1Koshijimi, specializing in black-clam products such as instant clam-flavored rice noodles and marinated frozen clams. It emphasizes sustainable aquaculture with ASC and organic certifications, uses recycled clam-shell eco-packaging, and stresses local and community engagement.
